items.title: Align Technology to add directors, launch review after deal with Elliott
items.summary: Align Technology will add three new independent directors to its board and launch a review of its operations ‌following talks with activist investor Elliott Investment Management, the company said ‌on Wednesday.  The three new board ​members, who have not yet been named, will be chosen for their expertise in healthcare technology, medical devices, global operations, and scaling high-growth businesses.  Elliott, one of Wall Street's most prominent activist investors, has increasingly turned its attention to ‌healthcare companies over the past ⁠year, often pushing for board representation and strategic reviews to boost performance.
